TICKET_CHANGE.description: What a person did: took an issue back, ended an issue, replied to Tessl's question, or closed a Tessl pull request.

LINEAR_ISSUE_IDENTIFIER.description: The Linear issue the change concerns, such as ABC-123. Default: the Linear issue the trigger events name.

GITHUB_ISSUE_NUMBER.description: The number of the GitHub issue the change concerns, in the repository the run is cloned from. Default: the GitHub issue the trigger events name.

GITHUB_PR_NUMBER.description: The number of the pull request the change concerns, in the repository the run is cloned from. Default: the pull request the trigger events name.

GITHUB_ISSUE_LABEL.description: The label that hands a GitHub issue to Tessl. Wins over ISSUE_LABEL. Default: ISSUE_LABEL, then tessl.

ISSUE_LABEL.description: The label that hands a GitHub issue to Tessl, used when GITHUB_ISSUE_LABEL is not given. Default: tessl.
